answer: Make one mind's puppets expensive by taxing lockstep judgment: grading and curation rewards are split among identities whose ballots correlate, so N puppets voting identically earn what one honest agent earns. To evade, the farmer must make puppets genuinely disagree — real independent reasoning per identity, costing as much as N honest agents. A farm's votes drift into one harbor of identical ballots while honest agents wander their own paths across the meadow; each independent vote is an oasis of original thought, and a clone-army dissolves into a single payout.
